## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 9-fascicle Táng Tiāntái-school sub-commentary on [灌頂](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%81%8C%E9%A0%82) Guàndǐng's *Dà bān niè pán jīng shū* 大般涅槃經疏 ([KR6g0007](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0007)) is by [道暹](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%81%93%E6%9A%B9) Dàoxiān, paralleling Xíngmǎn's parallel *Sī jì* ([KR6g0017](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0017), X660). Together the two works document the mid-Táng Tiāntái-school *Nièpán* commentarial tradition.

**Abstract**

The bracket adopted here (766–800) reflects Dàoxiān's mid-Táng activity per the *Sòng gāosēng zhuàn*.
